channel.title: Robotics Directory - Companion Robots
channel.description: Browse 176 companion robots in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: HatsuMuv CutieroidDoll Frame Arms Girl Gourai
item.description: CutieroidDoll Frame Arms Girl Gourai is a character robot doll from HatsuMuv modeled on the Frame Arms Girl franchise's Gourai, with 11 motorized axes (3 in the head, 4 per arm) plus free-moving torso, leg and wrist joints. It reacts to voice and touch sensors, tracks sound with its face, recognizes items via RFID, and ships with 97 performance routines, about 200 voiced lines and 47 motion patterns, controllable over Bluetooth from a companion app. Pre-orders opened in November 2026 for an August 2027 release.

item.title: Tombot Jennie
item.description: Realistic robotic Labrador puppy designed as an emotional-support companion for people who cannot care for a live pet.

item.title: Robopoet Fuzozo
item.description: Wearable furry AI companion charm, five-element personalities, multimodal emotion interaction, 120k+ sold

item.title: Tuya Smart Aura
item.description: Autonomous AI pet companion with laser play, feeding and emotion analysis.

item.title: Ludens AI Cocomo
item.description: Wheeled warm-touch AI pet that follows owners and hums instead of speaking.

item.title: Ludens AI Inu
item.description: Desktop AI pet with wagging tail and blinking single eye reacting to touch.

item.title: InsBotics Pophie
item.description: Evolving 5-DOF AI companion with long-term memory, gaze tracking and 12 languages.

item.title: Gogobot D1
item.description: Camera-free AI robot dog doing tricks with ToF sensors and voice conversation.

item.title: ZBy – Mind with Heart An'An
item.description: AI panda companion, also called AnAn. European launch announced September 3, 2026 with distributors in Germany and Belgium and September sales planned. Manufacturer quotes overseas retail pricing of 1,000–1,500 USD; this is not a confirmed German EUR price.

item.title: OLLOBOT OlloNi
item.description: OlloNi SS1, presented at IFA 2026 on September 5, is a mobile AI companion with household-member recognition and adaptive memory. The manufacturer postponed its late-August Kickstarter campaign; no replacement date was announced. Existing OlloNi catalog identity retained to avoid a duplicate.

item.title: Qiyuan Q1 Explorer
item.description: Personal robot from Qiyuan's Q1 line, shown in Explorer form around WAIC 2026 as part of the company's consumer robot lineup.

item.title: Qiyuan T1
item.description: Transformable personal robot from Qiyuan that can switch between wheel-legged humanoid-style movement and quadruped form for consumer companion use.

item.title: AheadForm Origin F1
item.description: Desktop ultra-bionic humanoid head for real-world interaction; vision and voice perception, face recognition, speech, dialogue and coordinated facial expressions across 26 DoF in the head, eyes and face modules.

item.title: AheadForm Elf Xuan
item.description: Bionic robotic head focused on stable long-term interaction, brand display, reception and emotional interaction; performed at Zhiyuan Robotics' Robot Wonder Night in 2026.

item.title: PrimeBOT Q1
item.description: Compact personal robot and embodied-intelligence creation platform from PrimeBOT, aimed at developers, educators and technology enthusiasts with expressive full-body motion and emotionally responsive interaction.

item.title: Tuya Smart Doova
item.description: Mobile home companion unveiled September 4, 2026 for independently living seniors. Tuya describes LiDAR navigation, voice interaction, reminders and smart-home coordination. Commercial availability and price were not announced.

item.title: Takway AI Sweekar
item.description: Egg-shaped, palm-sized AI pocket pet (a physical Tamagotchi successor) that grows through egg, baby, teen and adult stages based on interaction XP, with long-term voice and activity memory. Unveiled at CES 2026 and crowdfunded on Kickstarter. Takway AI was founded in Shenzhen in 2024.

item.title: SwitchBot KATA Friends
item.description: AI pet robot sold in two characters (Noa and Niko). Its on-device AI reacts to the owner's sleep patterns, mood and presence and keeps working offline. It moves around the home to greet people at the door, dances to music and responds to gestures. Optional care plans are sold separately.

item.title: Robosen Flagship Soundwave
item.description: Licensed Transformers G1 Soundwave robot that converts itself into a cassette-player form and doubles as a Bluetooth speaker. It has 28 servos, 48 voice commands and more than 200 lines recorded by the original voice actor. The app offers joystick control and free programming.

item.title: ECOVACS LilMilo
item.description: ECOVACS' first emotional AI companion robot (FAMIBOT line), shaped like a small plush dog. It recognises faces, gestures and voices and has five personality types and seven core emotions. Its expressive eyes and articulated head react to touch, and it can mimic voices. The camera switches off in sleep mode and images are stored on the device. Shown at CES 2026 and launched in May 2026.

item.title: CyboPal ONE
item.description: Desktop robotic terminal whose display moves on its own: it follows the user and switches between landscape and portrait. It is controlled by voice and gesture and works with AI agents to complete tasks. The Kickstarter campaign launched September 22, 2026.

item.title: KEYi Robot Loona Deskmate
item.description: Loona DeskMate is an AI desktop companion robot from KEYi Tech that uses a docked iPhone as its animated face and moves it with a 3-DoF (yaw, pitch, roll) system driven entirely by brushless servo motors. It connects to tools such as Gmail, Outlook, Slack and Notion to sort tasks and reminders, and its base provides 165 W GaN power delivery and 15 W Qi2 wireless charging. It was unveiled at CES 2026 and is sold through KEYi's online store.

item.title: SenseAuto Care U
item.description: Care U (Keyou) is a desktop AI companion robot launched in April 2026 by SenseAuto, SenseTime's smart-vehicle unit, as a home version of its 'New Member' cockpit emotion engine. It has a dual-microphone array with 180-degree pickup and up to 50 voiceprint IDs, a 2 MP camera, a 100 Hz six-axis gyroscope and a 1.75-inch OLED screen that rotates through 360 degrees, and it syncs a shared family memory with in-car AI, phones and PCs.

item.title: QwenWork QwenNote Eva
item.description: QwenNote Eva is a screenless desktop robot from Alibaba's Qwen Office (QwenWork) unit, launched at the 2026 Apsara Conference, that works with Android, iOS and HarmonyOS phones. It uses Qwen Office and DingTalk to execute tasks, take AI meeting notes and manage schedules, has a 3-axis motorized gimbal (about ±180° beam rotation, +15° pitch, ±20° horizontal) with magnetic wireless charging, and delivers up to 65 W GaN wired charging.

item.title: Huawei HAMOMO
item.description: HAMOMO is an AI companion robot for Huawei's HarmonyOS smart cockpit, unveiled at the Huawei Qiankun technology conference in April 2026. It attaches magnetically to the top edge of a car's center display, turns its head and shows expressions in real time together with Huawei's Xiaoyi assistant, and can be detached and carried as a standalone AI companion.

item.title: ZTE iMoochi
item.description: iMoochi is a plush AI pet robot from ZTE's terminal business, sold in China under the nubia brand, unveiled at MWC 2026 and released in July 2026. It has five touch-sensing points, voiceprint recognition and two small eye screens, reacts by shaking its head, wagging its tail and making non-verbal sounds, supports Wi-Fi and 4G, and offers 8-10 hours of use per charge on a contact charging base.

item.title: Haier Haiwa Companion Robot
item.description: The Haiwa Companion Robot is an elder-care companion robot in Haier's Haiwa family of household service robots, officially unveiled at AWE 2026 in Shanghai (March 2026) alongside the Haiwa Household Robot and Haiwa Cleaning Robot. It targets older family members with fall detection that triggers an app alert, scheduled reminders for dozens of medications, and health advice generated from a large health model using long-term blood-pressure records.

item.title: Robosen Fallen Leader Optimus Prime G1 Flagship
item.description: Fallen Leader Optimus Prime is a 40th-anniversary, battle-worn Flagship-grade auto-converting Transformers robot from Robosen with 27 servos and app-controlled programming modes. It is limited to 1,000 units in North America, with shipping estimated to begin in December 2026.

item.title: M5Stack StackChan
item.description: StackChan is an open-source AI desktop robot co-created by M5Stack and its community, using a CoreS3 (ESP32-S3) controller with a 2-inch touch display, camera, microphones and a body with two feedback servos for pan and tilt. Its firmware includes an AI agent, expressive animations and remote control, and it can be programmed with Arduino, UiFlow2 and ESP-IDF.

item.title: WhalesBot Pubbo
item.description: Pubbo is an AI companion robot for children aged 3 to 11 from Shanghai-based WhalesBot, combining conversational AI, a 5 MP camera for visual recognition, a 3.5-inch touchscreen, multi-zone touch sensing and dual microphones. Children can drive it on silicone wheels across an included 800 x 800 mm map and design its movements with visual coding; it has a 5,200 mAh battery rated for 2+ hours and launched in the US in November 2026.

item.title: SoulX MoYa
item.description: MoYa is a camera-free sleep-soothing robot from SoulX (Shenzhen Honghuo Intelligent Technology) that simulates hugging and rhythmic patting with a self-developed soft pneumatic structure driven by an air pump instead of electric motors. Sensors follow the user's breathing so the patting rhythm and force adapt dynamically; SoulX plans to launch it first in North America in 2026.

item.title: Figurobot FR-NIA
item.description: FR-NIA is an 11-inch (28 cm) desktop companion robot from Shanghai-based Figurobot with a biomimetic face covered in 2 mm silicone skin. Ten degrees of freedom across the face and neck drive coordinated eye, eyebrow and mouth movements with 0.01° control accuracy, while multimodal perception tracks user position and sound direction. It launched on Kickstarter in October 2026 in Lite, Pro and Pro Max configurations with early-bird pricing from 599 USD.

item.title: Hisense Moii
item.description: Home companion robot series from Hisense, shown at AWE 2026 and launched in July 2026 for elderly care and family use. It offers emotional companionship, learning games for children, reminders and elderly monitoring including fall detection, and voice control of whole-home Hisense appliances.

item.title: Cyan Robotics Amoo
item.description: Amoo is a small bipedal home companion robot from Shanghai-based Cyan Robotics, presented at AWE 2026 as an embodied character robot with a plush, fully soft-covered dragon-like body under 80 cm tall. It uses the company's Agentic OS and emotion-gait model for expressive eye, voice and body responses, has whole-body touch sensing and automatic recharging, and was shown ahead of its market launch.

item.title: OKA (One Kind Artifact) Mori
item.description: Mushroom-shaped, battery-powered desk companion robot (model ARTIFACT-01) that turns its glowing head toward activity, recognizes familiar people with an onboard camera, microphones and on-device AI, and plays nature-inspired light and sound experiences instead of acting as a voice assistant. Offered from late 2026 at a 649 USD First Access price against an 849 USD reference price.

item.title: Samsung Project Luna
item.description: Project Luna is a desktop AI companion robot concept Samsung unveiled at its 'Design Is an Act of Love' exhibition during Milan Design Week 2026 (April 20-26, 2026). It takes the form of a small round-faced unit with a rotating circular display on top that reacts with voice and motion, shown as the device that welcomes and later says goodbye to exhibition visitors while illustrating Samsung's AI vision of connecting home appliances.

item.title: Haivivi CocoMate
item.description: CocoMate is a small egg-shaped, clip-on AI companion toy from Haivivi, the maker of the BubblePal talking toy. It has a touch-sensitive glowing top panel, a built-in speaker and a carry strap, and Haivivi markets it as the first AI toy built on an end-to-end voice model for live spoken conversation.

item.title: Haivivi PingPal
item.description: PingPal is an AI interactive companion toy from Haivivi, maker of the BubblePal talking toy, marketed as 'PingPal - World's 1st Multi-Content AI Interactive Kids Toy' with a screen-free, Montessori-aligned design. As of November 2026 it is a Kickstarter pre-launch project ('Launching soon', 0 backers, no price set), linked from Haivivi's own site.

item.title: Haivivi LIITE AI Plush Toy
item.description: LIITE is a blind-box collectible AI plush toy sold by Haivivi (maker of BubblePal and CocoMate) under its TapDoki lifestyle art-toy line, pairing a furry designer character doll with a companion smartphone app that shows a virtual room and lets owners interact with their Doki character. Each box contains one of several randomly assigned costumed character designs, following a collect-them-all format.

item.title: Beans & Bits A Friend
item.description: A Friend is a soft-bodied AI companion device from the Tyrol, Austria startup Beans & Bits GmbH, combining cat-ear-shaped plush ears, an illuminated pixel-eye face and voice interaction with interchangeable outer shells for different colors. Built on the open-source OpenClaw personal-AI-agent framework, it remembers what its owner tells it between conversations, supports more than 20 languages, and can set alarms, manage to-dos, assist with cooking, recommend films and handle calendar entries and messages. The company launched Indiegogo crowdfunding for it in November 2026, with working prototypes but no finished product yet and shipping targeted for Q2 2027.

item.title: Familiar Machines & Magic Familiar
item.description: Familiar is the debut home-companion robot from Familiar Machines & Magic (FMM), a Boston-area startup founded by former iRobot CEO Colin Angle and co-founders Chris Jones and Ira Renfrew. Unlike a cleaning or talking robot, it is designed as an animal-like physical presence that expresses itself through body language, facial expressions and vocalizations, learns household routines, and builds a distinct personality and memory of its owner over time, storing its data on-device by default. It was unveiled in May 2026; the company has not yet disclosed a shipping date or price.

item.title: KingKong Technology Jumper
item.description: Jumper is an open-source crab-shaped robot from Beijing-based KingKong Technology, a company that originally made robot encoders and tactile servos. Its 400x400x200 mm crab-style body carries 22 high-torque tactile servos, weighs 1.8 kg, moves at over 0.5 m/s, can jump higher than 400 mm, grasp loads up to 1 kg, and runs about 2 hours per charge. The company released it as open-source hardware in 2026 with a free giveaway of 100 units.

item.title: Yukai Engineering Baby Fu-Fu
item.description: Baby Fu-Fu is a handy fan robot from Yukai Engineering, roughly twice the size of its sibling Nekojita Fu-Fu, built to blow a gentle, adjustable three-speed breeze on babies and small children. Its hands and feet clamp onto a stroller handle to aim the airflow, and its mouth fully encloses the spinning fan so little fingers cannot reach it; it was announced in January 2026 for a summer 2026 launch.

item.title: Huaxi Tech HT-X2
item.description: HT-X2 is a multifunctional embodied elder-care robot from Hangzhou-based Huaxi Tech (骅羲科技), one of the first companies the maker says has brought such a robot to market for home and institutional elderly care. It incorporates the company's own dexterous-hand and robotic-arm designs and elder-care AI model, and has been deployed across more than 20 Chinese provinces and various care institutions.

item.title: HeartMemo Kangkang
item.description: Kangkang (心忆康康) is a mobile home-companion robot from Beijing-based HeartMemo (心忆科技), built by a team pairing psychology and computer-science research into emotional computing. It moves around the home to approach family members, converses naturally, sings, tells stories, proactively starts conversations at appropriate moments, and keeps a layered family memory using the company's own BSLA companionship-decision framework; it ships in ivory, brown, pink and orange, and won a GEIA Excellence Service Robot award.

item.title: Ruko 1088 Large Smart Robot
item.description: Ruko 1088 Smart Robot is a 15.8-inch-tall consumer toy robot that dances to music with expressive movements and supports customizable dance routines. It is sold through Ruko's Amazon storefront in the US as part of the Hong Kong brand's holiday 2026 toy lineup.

item.title: Ruko 6088 Programmable Smart Robot
item.description: Ruko 6088 Programmable Robot is a consumer toy robot with gesture-sensing controls, an expressive LED face, and customizable action sequences. It is sold through Ruko's Amazon storefront in the US as part of the Hong Kong brand's holiday 2026 toy lineup.

item.title: Ruko 8809 RC Dinosaur Smart Robot
item.description: Ruko 8809 Robot Dinosaur is a consumer toy robot dinosaur with roaring sounds, dynamic walking movements, interactive remote controls and a soft foam dart-firing feature. It is sold through Ruko's Amazon storefront in the US as part of the Hong Kong brand's holiday 2026 toy lineup.

item.title: Xinyan Robotics Bubbo
item.description: Bubbo 1 (巴布) is a home AI companion robot from Beijing-based Xinyan Robotics, built around the company's own "Xinyuan" emotional-companionship language model and "Bubbo OS" robot operating system to deliver native multimodal perception, long-term memory, emotion understanding and proactive, in-the-moment interaction. It stands about 65 cm tall with a rounded cream-and-apricot body and expressive animated eyes that react to touch and context, positioning it as a family-companionship device rather than an industrial platform.

item.title: Lingyan Technology Lyra S1
item.description: Lyra S1 is an ultra-bionic interactive robot face/head unveiled by Hangzhou Lingyan Technology (brand FaceSoul), using a cable-driven bionic-muscle mechanism to reach 32 facial degrees of freedom, dynamic pupils with visual tracking for eye contact, and a proprietary multimodal 'Amygdala' model that generates real-time lip-synced micro-expressions from speech instead of preset animations. It is sold as an embodied-AI interaction module to humanoid-robot OEMs plus education, research and commercial-service customers, with a lower-cost consumer companion version planned later; the core team originates from Jilin University's engineering bionics lab.
